# Daily Report — 2026-10-03

## Task Completed
Add SLA breach notification tools: `list_at_risk_slas`, `create_sla_breach_notification`,
`list_sla_breach_events`.

- `list_at_risk_slas` — queries `task_sla` for records where `has_breached=false` and
  `percentage >= threshold` (default 80%), letting operators spot imminent breaches before
  they are recorded. Filters: `table_name`, `stage`, pagination.
- `create_sla_breach_notification` — POSTs a `sysevent` record (default name `sla.breach`)
  with `task_sys_id` as `parm1` and optional `sla_sys_id` as `parm2`. ServiceNow's built-in
  notification engine picks up the event and dispatches configured alerts.
- `list_sla_breach_events` — queries `sysevent` filtered by event name (default `sla.breach`),
  state, and source for auditing which notifications have been fired.

New file: `src/servicenow_mcp/tools/sla_notification_tools.py`
Registered in: `__init__.py`, `tool_utils.py`, `config/tool_packages.yaml`
(service_desk, system_administrator, full packages)
